title: Eric Davis's notes from the Advanced Physics Theoretical Working Group
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Eric Davis's notes from the Advanced Physics Theoretical Working Group, about 2000s at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: for me because Eric Davis had given me his notes from the advanced physics theoretical working group.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says a physicist named Eric Davis gave him his notes from a group called the Advanced Physics Theoretical Working Group, which met in the 2000s in the United States. Cameron says the notes mattered a great deal to him, because, if they are what he describes, they would give an inside look at scientists studying advanced physics linked to the UFO question.
